name: @bossnyumba/privacy-router
description: Sensitivity-tier AI routing for the BossNyumba real-estate operating system. Routes inference requests by data-sensitivity tier to satisfy Tanzania BOT Act / PDPA data-residency rules: RESTRICTED -> local model only (deny if unavailable), CONFIDENTIAL -> approved cloud provider after mandatory PII stripping, INTERNAL / PUBLIC -> approved cloud. Policy is YAML-driven and operator-editable. Wire-agnostic pure leaf: PII stripping, local-endpoint health, field classification, audit, and the clock are all injected ports, so the package reads no DB, no network, and no environment.
